unit.why: This short paragraph continues the account of the tzaddik's last winter before his death, begun in the previous division ("והנה אז בכל החורף ההוא"). It describes his changed habit at the third Sabbath meal and has no self-contained plot.
unit.boundary_note: Continues the last-winter / approaching-death sequence from the previous division; the sequence goes on into the next division (his stay in Radom).

stories.summary_en: In his last winter the tzaddik, against all his former custom, gave plain moral rebuke with much weeping at every third Sabbath meal, where before he only sang the zemirot with fervor.
